subject: Topline coverage sweep — action items for forecast lock
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearview.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Topline coverage sweep — action items for forecast lock

Team / Tom,

As we head into forecast lock next Friday (Nov 20), I ran a quick topline coverage check versus quota and flagged a couple of gaps that need immediate attention. Attached is a very small rollup (coverage_summary_Q4.xlsx) and a one-page MOP template for commit certification. High-level: we’re ~0.9x coverage on current weighted amount for the US quota (gap ~ $2.1M) and have several late-stage deals that need explicit commit or downgrades.

Can each AE/owner reply with:
- Stage changes (if any) by EOD Wed Nov 18
- If you intend to commit for forecast lock, confirm amount and earliest close date
- Any external blockers (e.g., procurement, integration demo, legal) and whom to loop in

Tom / ClearView: I know you’ve been close on the SOW for RW integration — if you can confirm timing this week that helps clean up the net-new demand.

Deliverables:
- Fill out the attached MOP_template.docx and drop back to me (or update the shared drive)
- I’ll consolidate and publish a final commit rollup on Thursday evening

Thanks — short and focused here.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: coverage_summary_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), MOP_template.docx (template stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearview.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Topline coverage sweep — action items for forecast lock

Thanks Neha — quick update from my side after a 1:1 with AEs. TL;DR: we can recover ~ $900k with two plays; remaining ~ $1.2M is high-risk.

Plays in flight:
- CLV-98765 (ClearView) — moving to Contract Review after procurement call on Tue 11/17; AE expects close 11/19 but procurement may push to 11/23. Recommend priority escalation if we need it for lock. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLV-98765
- RW-EMEA-221 — cross-sell to existing logo, close by 11/20 if partner demo completes; I’ll ping Markus to confirm partner slot.

High-risk bucket (~$1.2M):
- Two RD deals in discovery that are at BANT stage but have no exec sponsor — ask AEs to move to disqualified or provide documented next steps by Wed.

Actions I will take:
- Prioritize ClearView escalation if Neha approves
- Consolidate AE MOPs into Neha’s sheet by Wed EOD

-Mark
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Neha, Vivek — thanks for the heads up. Quick note from ClearView:
- Procurement is aiming for legal review on 11/18; commercial has sign-off but we need the final SOW updated to include the RBAC addendum. If RW can deliver that by end of day Tue 11/17, we should be OK for 11/19.
- Anna (cc) will coordinate with our integration lead for a demo slot; earliest slot they can commit to is 11/20.

I’m happy to do a short MAP (mutual action plan). If you can send the MOP with dates we’ll align and return a signed draft.

Tom Lee
Director of Systems | ClearView Analytics
Tom.Lee@clearview.com

Thanks all for the quick turn. Final consolidated notes / commitments for forecast lock: 

Net effect (US quota):
- Starting weighted pipeline: $10.6M
- Confirmed commits added: +$1.05M (ClearView incremental $750k; RW-EMEA-221 $300k)
- Disqualified / removed: -$200k
- Final locked weighted: $11.45M (~1.05x coverage)

Open risks (callouts):
- ClearView procurement still pending RBAC addendum; Vivek to escalate to procurement contact if not signed by EOD Tue (11/17) — Tom, appreciate the push from your side.
- Two small RD deals remain uncommitted ($420k) — AEs to provide final MOPs by EOD Wed (11/18) or we move them to OPP.

Attachments published: final_commit_rollup.csv (consolidated commits), updated MOPs in shared drive (link below).

Next steps:
- Forecast lock confirmed Thu 11/19 9am PT — finance will take the rollup for final numbers
- Post-lock forecast review: Fri 11/20 11am PT — 30m stand-up if any late moves

Thanks everyone for the fast responses — please treat the deadlines as firm. I’ll follow up with a short note to Finance once the DocuSign shows ClearView’s signature.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
